title: A rectangle
prompt: Draw a rectangle 80 wide and 30 tall, turning left at each corner: 80, left, 30, left, 80, left, 30, left.

tests.name: Long, short, long, short with left turns

hints: Opposite sides of a rectangle are equal.
Alternate 80 and 30 with a turn_left() after each.

docs.name: move_forward(distance)
docs.what: Drives the turtle forward that many pixels, drawing a line. Takes one number; returns nothing.

docs.name: turn_left()
docs.what: Turns the turtle 90 degrees to the left. Give it a number to turn by a different angle.

solution:
func run():
	move_forward(80)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(80)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
